entry.title: Soie 0.1.6
entry.content:
Added

  • Content-Encoding: br over HTTPS, when brotli's decoder (libbrotlidec) is there at build time: pages and scripts come 15 to 20 % smaller than with gzip.
  • A drop-down <select> opens a pop-up list of its options on a click, or with Space, Enter, F4 or Alt+Down: the current option highlighted, <optgroup> labels bold with their options indented, disabled options greyed, in the select's font and the system colours of its color scheme. The pointer, the arrows, Home, End, Page Up and Down move in it, a click, Enter or Space picks, Escape or a click elsewhere closes it, letters jump to the option they start. A long list fits in the view and scrolls; a select at the bottom opens it upwards. A click cycled through the options before, with no way to see them. A focused select also changes with the arrows and letters, list closed. The shell paints the list over the page: xsoie, wsoie and SoieView all have it.
  • A page dark by color-scheme alone (:root { color-scheme: dark }, <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">, or light dark when the user prefers dark) gets the dark canvas, light text, links and dark form controls, as in Firefox: it stayed white with black text. System colors (Canvas, CanvasText, ButtonFace...) follow the element's color scheme.
  • font-variant: small-caps (and font-variant-caps, all-small-caps, the font shorthand's small-caps): small caps were drawn as plain lowercase. Synthesized as in Firefox, capitals at 0.8 of the size.
  • tab-size (a number of spaces or a length): tabs in <pre> were always 8 columns, counted from the start of each text node, so a tab after a <b> or in a proportional font missed its stop. Tab stops are now measured from the content edge, as in browsers.
  • WOFF2 web fonts, when FreeType is built with brotli: most sites' fonts were skipped and their text came in DejaVu, with other widths. A FreeType without brotli falls back as before.

Fixed

  • -webkit-line-clamp drew no ellipsis at the end of its last line: clamped texts stopped short without a sign of it. line-clamp is accepted as its alias.
  • border-radius: a / b and the two values of border-*-radius: the radii down were dropped, elliptical corners came out circular.
  • Grid placement by line names: grid-column: col 3 (the third line named col), span name, names repeated by repeat(4, [col] 1fr) and names the grid does not have (past it, as in browsers) all put items in the first columns.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.5
entry.content:
Added

  • Shadow DOM: shadow trees render in place of their host's children, <slot> elements show the host's children (named, default, fallback content). Their <style> and adopted constructed sheets apply to them only, with :host, :host(), :host-context() and ::slotted(); the document's rules stay out. Custom elements upgrade inside shadow trees. Scripts get assignedNodes(), assignedElements(), assignedSlot, getRootNode({ composed }), isConnected through hosts. Web components (Lit, Stencil...) showed nothing. Library: soie_attach_shadow(), soie_shadow_root(), soie_shadow_host(), soie_shadow_open(), soie_shadow_css(), soie_assigned_slot().
  • color-scheme, and light-dark() follows it element by element: a dark section of a light page (MDN's home page header) was light, its text unreadable.
  • :defined is real: a custom element matches it once its class came. Pages hide their components until then (x-menu:not(:defined) { display: none }), and lit.dev showed its mobile drawer over the page. Library: soie_element_set_defined().
  • import.meta.url in module scripts and imported modules: reddit's loader resolved its lazy chunks against undefined.
  • attachInternals() and a minimal ElementInternals (states, validity, the shadow root): Material's components threw without it. Its states is a CustomStateSet: :state(x) and the older :--x match them. Library: soie_element_set_states().
  • ::part() (CSS Shadow Parts), the styling interface of Shoelace, Web Awesome, Ionic and Material components: x-tab::part(base), several names, ::part(x)::before / ::after, :host::part(x) from the component itself, and exportparts to forward the parts of nested components. An outer tree's ::part() declarations win over the component's own, its style attributes included, and lose for !important. Scripts get element.part.
  • window.cookieStore (get, getAll, set, delete) over document.cookie, without change events.
  • Shadow DOM events: the path goes through the slots of slotted nodes and from a shadow root to its host for composed events (the user's clicks, keys, focus, input...; composed: true for scripts'), listeners outside a tree see its host as target and relatedTarget, composedPath() hides closed trees from outside, a host gets its tree's events at target. document.activeElement is the host of a focused element of a shadow tree, shadowRoot.activeElement the element; elementFromPoint() gives the host. slotchange events.
  • Declarative shadow DOM: <template shadowrootmode=open|closed> in a parsed document gives its parent a shadow root (not in innerHTML).
  • The browser follows a link or a button around a shadow tree or around the slot of a slotted node, edits text fields, checkboxes and details inside shadow trees; a form of a shadow tree submits its own controls, an outer form leaves the tree's.
  • :host inside :is() and :where(); animation events in shadow trees; document.adoptedStyleSheets.push() applies.
  • attachShadow() on a host the parser gave a declarative root of that mode empties it and returns it, as browsers do: server-side rendered components (Lit SSR, Stencil, Enhance) threw at upgrade. Library: soie_shadow_claim().
  • delegatesFocus: a host's focus() goes to the first focusable element of its tree; clonable and serializable reflect the options; getHTML() and setHTMLUnsafe() on shadow roots (without shadow roots inside). focus() and blur() fire focusout, focus events carry relatedTarget.

Changed

  • attachShadow() throws NotSupportedError on elements that cannot host a shadow root (img, i...), as browsers do.
  • Events at their target run their capturing listeners first, as browsers do now (they ran in the order they were added); composedPath() is empty once the event was dispatched.
  • Tree context in the cascade comes before the style attribute, as CSS Cascade 5 says: a component's :host { x !important } wins over the host's style="x !important" (it lost).
  • Shadow roots that adopt the same style sheets (every instance of a Lit component) share one parse of them: 300 instances added one by one took over 5 s (the script was stopped), now 0.1 s. Shadow trees whose <style> elements have the same text (server-side rendered components) do too: 4000 such components took 0.69 s to lay out, 0.14 s now, as many plain elements 0.12 s.
  • soie_attach_shadow() takes the elements DOM's attachShadow() takes only, and soie_node_free() of a shadow root that still has its host does nothing: the host's boxes kept its nodes.

Fixed

  • Shadow DOM, after a review: :host::before and ::after styled the host itself (no pseudo-element, the host red or 30 px high); a component's .dark :host, body :host span or .a + :host matched the host's real ancestors and siblings; cascade layers were global to the page, a component's @layer order changed the document's; shadow trees nested 100,000 deep overflowed the stack and 20,000 took 3 s; a light-dark() of the wrong syntax was kept, and @supports said yes to it.
  • Closed shadow roots were readable by any page: through the event's _path, new ElementInternals(host), host._internals and the _roots of an adopted sheet. ElementInternals and CustomStateSet cannot be constructed by pages any more.
  • A parsed shadow root fired slotchange on every slot at its first change; focus moving inside one shadow tree fired blur, focus and focusin on its host; a relatedTarget that is the host did not stop the path there; adoptedStyleSheets gave another object after each assignment (a list kept and pushed to undid the change); attachInternals() worked on any element; 2000 roots sharing a sheet took 0.45 s to adopt it (37 ms now).
  • A custom element moved in the page gets disconnectedCallback before connectedCallback; stopImmediatePropagation() in an on* handler stops the listeners after it.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.4
entry.content:
Added

  • aspect-ratio on every box: cards, video embeds and thumbnails sized by a ratio were 0 px high.
  • SVG in a page styled by CSS: fill, stroke and the other paint properties from rules, classes, currentColor and var(), a <style> inside the SVG, sizes with units. Icon systems that paint through a class were black or missing.
  • Gradients as real background images: background-size, -position and -repeat apply to them; repeating and conic gradients, radial shapes, sizes and centres, color hints, stops with two positions.
  • background-origin and background-clip, background-repeat: space and round, positions of three and four values, sizes and positions with units and calc().
  • @keyframes and animation: nothing moves, but an element that an animation leaves in its last keyframe (forwards) is shown there; content faded in from opacity: 0 stayed invisible. Scripts get animationstart and animationend.
  • Transforms that rotate, scale or skew (rotate(), scale(), skew(), matrix(), the rotate, scale and translate properties, transform-origin): carets, chevrons and flipped icons were drawn as they lie.
  • background-clip: text and -webkit-text-fill-color: gradient text.
  • text-overflow: ellipsis.
  • More -webkit- names of properties Soie has (flex, transform, box-shadow, background-clip...).
  • Form controls sized as in browsers (text fields, selects as wide as their options, list boxes) and drawn: range, color, file, <progress>, <meter>; unstyled controls get a thin rounded ring.
  • JavaScript: a minimal Intl (English conventions) and the toLocale... methods with their options.
  • JavaScript: style sheets as objects (sheet.cssRules, insertRule(), document.styleSheets, new CSSStyleSheet(), adoptedStyleSheets), the factory methods of <svg>: sites that test features with Modernizr no longer hide their icons.
  • revert.
  • CSS counters: counter-reset, counter-increment, counter-set, counter() and counters().
  • A positioned inline box is the containing block of its absolute descendants.
  • Lines break after hyphens and slashes, and between Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters.

Changed

  • Lines are as high as in Firefox and Chrome: font ascent and descent in whole pixels (19 px for DejaVu Sans at 16 px, it was 18.625).
  • The background images of the root or of the body cover the whole page, as their color did.
  • Background images are placed from the padding box, as specified, not from the border box.

Security

  • The same-origin policy and CORS of fetch(), XMLHttpRequest, modules and importScripts() are enforced by the engine, from the origin it knows: a page that rewrote the objects of its own scripts (URL.prototype.origin, Headers.prototype.get, eval in a worker) could read other origins' answers, send forged Origin headers and read HttpOnly cookies from Set-Cookie.
  • A response that is not HTML (JSON, a script) is never parsed as HTML.
  • A navigation started by the page alone is held by the private network guard, like its other requests.
  • An endless loop on a body wrongly said compressed.

Fixed

  • Floats keep their source order when one waits for the next line; a transformed box holds its absolute descendants.
  • Deeply nested flex containers took exponential time to lay out (4.5 s for 22 levels, now 4 ms).
  • JavaScript: form.submit() of a POST form (logins and payments that post by script).
  • JavaScript: :scope in queries, location = url, forms' controls and the page's elements by name (form.q, out.textContent), javascript: links, Object.prototype.toString on platform objects, checkboxes changed before their click event.
  • Forms: long textareas sent whole, options in an <optgroup>.
  • The Host header carries the port; a body cut short is not cached.
  • white-space: nowrap: a nowrap run moves to the next line whole, inline-blocks no longer wrap inside it.
  • A word made of several inline boxes (<b>W</b>ord, a comma after a link) is no longer cut between them.
  • flex-direction: row-reverse and column-reverse start from the other edge.
  • Tabs in preformatted text.
  • A float was hidden by the background of the block after its parent.
  • <details> without a <summary> shows "Details".
  • Inline-blocks, inline images and inline boxes moved by position: relative.
  • Tables: a cell's height is a minimum (text ran over the next row), the table's height, <col> and <colgroup> widths.
  • Grid: heights in percent or from outside, min-height, items spanning several tracks, images as items, calc() and viewport units in track sizes.
  • Floats: a shrink-to-fit box holds its floats side by side; a box that does not fit beside a float goes below it.
  • Absolute boxes centred with margin: auto between their offsets (modals, spinners) stayed in the corner.
  • :is() and :where() with arguments of different kinds (a class and a tag) never matched.
  • A stack overflow on a gradient of more than 32 stops, a crash on grid lines beyond 46340, on 200000 nested display: contents, on a rule of more than 32767 selectors; endless loops and memory blow-ups on huge background positions, shadow blurs, var() chains, <use> trees, roman list markers and long descendant selectors.
  • Next.js sites (free.fr) showed their error screen: removeAttributeNode() was missing and attachShadow() threw. A shadow root now exists for scripts; its content is not rendered yet.
  • Sizes no page means (boxes of 1e10 px, flex: -1, grid lines in the millions, giant SVG text) froze the painter or the layout, and one read a byte before an array: found by fuzzing, all bounded.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.3
entry.content:
Added

  • HTTP Basic logins: a page that answers 401 opens about:auth, the login is kept in memory for its site and forgotten with the cookies (CUPS administration, routers).
  • An HTTP cache in memory (Cache-Control, ETag and Last-Modified revalidation), partitioned by the site of the top page: back to a Wikipedia article in 0.4 s instead of 1.35.
  • A private network guard: a public page reaches no address of the local network nor of the machine, a local network page none of the machine.
  • box-shadow, outer and inset, with spread and blur.
  • Elliptical corners: border-radius: 50% of a box that is not square is an ellipse.
  • overflow, images and background images clipped to rounded corners.
  • <details> and <summary>: closed, only the summary shows; a click on it opens or closes it.
  • display: -webkit-box with -webkit-line-clamp.
  • Fonts chosen by width (condensed, expanded), font-stretch in the font shorthand.
  • Grid lines named after an area's edges (name-start, name-end).
  • JavaScript: crypto.subtle HMAC and PBKDF2, raw keys (ALTCHA captchas, Mojeek), performance.navigation, PromiseRejectionEvent.

Changed

  • Border corners are mitred: CSS triangles (the carets of Bootstrap and many menus) are triangles; rounded borders keep each side's color and style; dots are round.
  • JavaScript: no touch event handlers, as desktop browsers: sites no longer take Soie for a phone.
  • vertical-align: super and sub raise and lower the glyphs, text decorations stay at their box's baseline.
  • FormData bodies are sent as multipart/form-data, fetch() bodies bring their content type.
  • element.style gives colors back as rgb(), as browsers do.

Fixed

  • A flex container lost a height set from outside: OpenStreetMap's map was blank. Stretched items are laid out again at their line's height, a single line keeps its min and max heights.
  • Links inside an inline box (Hacker News) could not be clicked.
  • about:blank gave an error page.
  • fetch() and XMLHttpRequest in workers never worked.
  • A timer set by a promise waited for another event (ALTCHA froze).
  • Cookie expiry dates took the day of the month as the hour.
  • The page height took in fixed boxes, and missed what overflows the root.
  • Quoted url() and url() in custom properties were resolved against the page, not their style sheet: missing icons and backgrounds.
  • document.createElement() refused valid names.
  • Images with min or max sizes and both sizes auto kept their ratio as CSS 2.1 says.
  • The caret of a password field is placed among its bullets.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.2
entry.content:
Added

  • Baseline alignment in flex lines and grid rows; inline-flex and inline-grid sit on their first baseline.
  • flex-wrap: wrap-reverse.
  • The static position of absolute children of flex and grid containers follows their alignment; a positioned grid container is the containing block of its absolute children's grid areas.
  • The grid and grid-template shorthands.
  • Grid: space-around and space-evenly content distribution, auto-fit collapsing its empty tracks, auto-fill/auto-fit rows in a grid of definite height.

Changed

  • Backgrounds and borders are painted on whole pixels, as browsers paint them: sharp table grids, no line of a box showing through another at the same place. Border widths are whole pixels.
  • Connections to a page's server are opened while the page loads, for its resources: Hacker News loads in 1.2 s instead of 1.9.

Fixed

  • Flex items' automatic minimum size: images (through their aspect ratio), overflow: clip, a column item's content height without its own height.
  • A column's item that does not stretch is as wide as its content, not the line.
  • The max-content width of a grid with fr columns.
  • xsoie crashed at the first paint on a 16-bit X server (old cards, fbdev, cirrus); it now converts to 16-bit, 15-bit, 24-bit and 8-bit colormap visuals.
  • Grid line names given before the first track were lost (and leaked).
  • soie.h gave the version as 0.1.0 in 0.1.1; make check now compares it with the Makefile's.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.1
entry.content:
Added

  • about:settings, the settings page of xsoie and wsoie, kept in ~/.config/soie/settings.
  • The fronts follow the desktop's dark or light theme.
  • The logo, an S of three silk threads: icons, window icon, favicon.

Changed

  • Checkboxes and radio buttons are drawn as browsers draw them, placeholders are faded.
  • SVG curves are cut finer when they are large on screen.

Fixed

  • history.pushState() and replaceState() keep the page's origin: in 0.1.0 a page could take another site's address (security).
  • Flex column items are measured at their laid out width, max-width included.
  • The auto width of a replaced box with a height follows its ratio.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.0
entry.content:
Added

  • First public release.
  • libsoie: HTML parsed as the WHATWG says (html5lib tree tests), the CSS cascade (css-parsing-tests), blocks, inline text, tables, flexbox, grid and SVG, painted with FreeType and HarfBuzz; incremental restyle and layout.
  • Extensions: cookies, content blocking, WebP, JavaScript with QuickJS (DOM, fetch, workers), audio and video with FFmpeg and Media Source Extensions.
  • Browsers: xsoie (X11), wsoie (Wayland), SoieView (GTK 3 widget).
  • soie-render, a headless renderer for tests and screenshots.
